name: Shenzhou 16
about: Shenzhou 16 (2023-077A), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou), launched 2023 May 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2023 May 30), held fixed
docked to S48274; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q115593337), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory
